mcq_drop.why: oddly worded: asks what an exam key said; definition actually describes malware, not virus

pyq_bad.why: suspect key: 'binary code' is a computer term; wrong topic: computer basics

patterns: APPSC asks current-affairs-flavoured one-liners: Petya/WannaCry = ransomware (G2 2025), digital arrest = criminals' scare term (G2 2025), e-Nagarpalika = MP (G1 2024), Telangana first cyber-trafficking case (G2 2023), firewall purpose (2025).
Other PSCs ask definitional items: phishing, spoofing, spam, e-mail bombing, DoS/DDoS, Trojan, virus self-replication, Pegasus = Israel, Stuxnet = Iran centrifuges.
Trap: key-based definitions where the expected answer is the colloquial term (virus for malware, digital arrest as scam not police action).
App MCQs mirror these well; some add 2025-26 report/data trivia (MeitY threat report, CERT-In counts) beyond PYQ depth.
